extract_batch over URI inputs

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
from xberg import extract_batch, ExtractInput, ExtractInputKind

async def main() -> None:
    inputs = [ExtractInput(kind=ExtractInputKind("uri"), uri="https://example.com/pdf/fake_memo.pdf"), ExtractInput(kind=ExtractInputKind("uri"), uri="https://example.com/text/fake_text.txt")]
    result = await extract_batch(inputs)
    for result in result.results:
        print(result.content)

asyncio.run(main())
```
